title: Codeland live message
description: Messages the live server (codeland-live) sends to clients over its WebSocket. Raw hook payloads are normalized server-side; file contents, diffs and command output are never forwarded.

snapshot.description: First message on every connection: recent history, oldest first.

repository.description: Name of the observed repository folder.

kind.description: edit covers Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit; search covers Grep and Glob.

phase.description: start = PreToolUse, end = PostToolUse or PostToolUseFailure, status = lifecycle.

path.description: Repository-relative target with forward slashes: a file for read/edit, a folder for search ("" = root); null when outside the repository or not applicable.

detail.description: Short human label (e.g. the Bash description or a truncated command).

tests.description: Verdict of a finished test command (vitest, jest, pytest, npm test, ...); null for every other event. Only the verdict and counts are forwarded, never the output.

change.description: Effect of a finished edit of a TypeScript file, measured on disk: metrics before the agent's first edit of that file and now. Null for every other event.

before.description: Null when the agent created the file.

after.description: Null when the file no longer exists.

decisions.description: Branching points (complexity minus one per function).

outcome.description: fail when the command exited non-zero or reported failed tests.

passed.description: Passed tests when the summary could be parsed.

failed.description: Failed tests when the summary could be parsed.
